{{Quote|You're an honorable officer, from a proud Core World family. There's never been any question in Thrawn's mind that he can trust you.|Commander Voss Parck, to Captain Dagon Niriz|<ref name="CD" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dagon Niriz]], who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', belonged to a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] '''family'''.<ref name="CD" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Command Decision]]'' to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn,"<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> tested Niriz's loyalty to [[Gender/Legends|him]] during a [[Skirmish between the Admonitor and Creysis's scout squadron|skirmish]] against the [[Ebruchi]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. After the defeat of the Ebruchi forces, Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] told Niriz that Thrawn trusted him, remarking that the captain was a member of a proud Core World family.<ref name="CD" /> Eventually, Niriz became a member of Thrawn's [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="VTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The family first appeared in the short story "[[Command Decision]]," written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11]] in [[November]], [[1996]].<ref name="CD" />
